verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents an `ai_query` parameter that takes a plain-language description of the information to extract. It also documents `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction as an alternative to CSS/XPath `extract_rules`, recommended when fields are semantic or the page structure is irregular. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the structured output schema and format for `ai_extract_rules`, accuracy or reliability details, and independent or hands-on corroboration that AI extraction works as claimed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from a page using natural language instructions instead of writing selectors

citations.quote: ai_query [string] ("") The information you want to extract from the webpage using AI
Use `extract_rules` for CSS/XPath-based extraction and `ai_query` or `ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction.
Choose AI extraction when the desired field is semantic or the structure is irregular.
